notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Tower Keepers
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33864772/d00807f07860ef9e32954f24e1684ccb39a1c588.jpg[/img]
Tower Keepers is Now Available on Steam! 

Train an epic army of heroes and defend your tower against all enemies. 
From the creators of the best-selling Bloons TD 6. Embark on more than 75 unique missions against 70+ monster types, each with their own special attacks. Loot your foes, discover hidden treasure chests, and complete quests to unlock new skills, weapons, and armor for each hero. Enchant your items or craft new ones to maximize your power, then enter Hero Battles and pit your best team of heroes against other players in real-time head to head play.

Become more awesomer and build your heroes, customize your teams, and enjoy the epic fun in Tower Keepers!
